newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ concerned about a fall in long-term rates - Jiji.
newsitem.headline: BOJ concerned about a fall in long-term rates - Jiji.

text.p: The Bank of Japan is concerned about any excessive decline in long-term interest rates, Jiji news agency reported on Friday.
Jiji did not provide a source for its report.
Comments from the BOJ were not immediately available.
Recent moves in Japan's long-term interest rates run counter to the firm trend in share prices, which is reflecting the BOJ's view that the economy is recovering gradually, Jiji said.
"The BOJ is worried that long-term interest rates are falling excessively," Jiji said.
